# Block identifiers

```````````````````````````````` example
Some text #abc#

Tabbed→#t1#
.
Document scope=1:1..3:11 anchor=null attributes={} children=2
├── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:15 anchor="abc" attributes={} children=1
│   └── Text scope=1:1..1:9 anchor=null attributes={} literal="Some text" children=0
└── Paragraph scope=3:1..3:11 anchor="t1" attributes={} children=1
    └── Text scope=3:1..3:6 anchor=null attributes={} literal="Tabbed" children=0
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
text
#abc#
.
Document scope=1:1..2:5 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── Paragraph scope=1:1..2:5 anchor="abc" attributes={} children=1
    └── Text scope=1:1..1:4 anchor=null attributes={} literal="text" children=0
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
first
second
#id#
.
Document scope=1:1..3:4 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── Paragraph scope=1:1..3:4 anchor="id" attributes={} children=3
    ├── Text scope=1:1..1:5 anchor=null attributes={} literal="first" children=0
    ├── SoftBreak scope=1:6..1:6 anchor=null attributes={} children=0
    └── Text scope=2:1..2:6 anchor=null attributes={} literal="second" children=0
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
- a
- b

#lst#

next
.
Document scope=1:1..6:4 anchor=null attributes={} children=2
├── List scope=1:1..4:5 anchor="lst" attributes={} flavor=bullet start=null variant=null delimiter=null tight=true children=2
│   ├── ListItem scope=1:1..1:3 anchor=null attributes={} marker=null children=1
│   │   └── Paragraph scope=1:3..1:3 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│   │       └── Text scope=1:3..1:3 anchor=null attributes={} literal="a" children=0
│   └── ListItem scope=2:1..3:0 anchor=null attributes={} marker=null children=1
│       └── Paragraph scope=2:3..2:3 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│           └── Text scope=2:3..2:3 anchor=null attributes={} literal="b" children=0
└── Paragraph scope=6:1..6:4 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    └── Text scope=6:1..6:4 anchor=null attributes={} literal="next" children=0
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
> quote

#q#

| h |
| - |
| c |

#tbl#
.
Document scope=1:1..9:5 anchor=null attributes={} children=2
├── Callout scope=1:1..3:3 anchor="q" attributes={} variant=null collapsed=null children=1
│   └── Paragraph scope=1:3..1:7 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│       └── Text scope=1:3..1:7 anchor=null attributes={} literal="quote" children=0
└── Table scope=5:1..9:5 anchor="tbl" attributes={} columns=[none:null] children=2
    ├── TableHead children=1
    │   └── TableRow scope=5:1..5:5 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    │       └── TableCell scope=5:2..5:4 anchor=null attributes={} rowspan=1 colspan=1 children=1
    │           └── Text scope=5:3..5:3 anchor=null attributes={} literal="h" children=0
    ├── TableBody children=1
    │   └── TableRow scope=7:1..7:5 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    │       └── TableCell scope=7:2..7:4 anchor=null attributes={} rowspan=1 colspan=1 children=1
    │           └── Text scope=7:3..7:3 anchor=null attributes={} literal="c" children=0
    └── TableFoot children=0
````````````````````````````````

# Boundary cases

## suffix-before-trailing-space

```````````````````````````````` example
  text #Ab-09# →
.
Document scope=1:1..1:16 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── Paragraph scope=1:3..1:16 anchor="Ab-09" attributes={} children=1
    └── Text scope=1:3..1:6 anchor=null attributes={} literal="text" children=0
````````````````````````````````

## own-line-indent

```````````````````````````````` example
text
    #bad#

text
   #good#
.
Document scope=1:1..5:9 anchor=null attributes={} children=2
├── Paragraph scope=1:1..2:9 anchor=null attributes={} children=3
│   ├── Text scope=1:1..1:4 anchor=null attributes={} literal="text" children=0
│   ├── SoftBreak scope=1:5..1:5 anchor=null attributes={} children=0
│   └── Text scope=2:5..2:9 anchor=null attributes={} literal="#bad#" children=0
└── Paragraph scope=4:1..5:9 anchor="good" attributes={} children=1
    └── Text scope=4:1..4:4 anchor=null attributes={} literal="text" children=0
````````````````````````````````

## own-line-tab

```````````````````````````````` example
text
→#bad#
.
Document scope=1:1..2:6 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── Paragraph scope=1:1..2:6 anchor=null attributes={} children=3
    ├── Text scope=1:1..1:4 anchor=null attributes={} literal="text" children=0
    ├── SoftBreak scope=1:5..1:5 anchor=null attributes={} children=0
    └── Text scope=2:2..2:6 anchor=null attributes={} literal="#bad#" children=0
````````````````````````````````

## continued-suffix-indent

```````````````````````````````` example
text
    more #good#
.
Document scope=1:1..2:15 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── Paragraph scope=1:1..2:15 anchor="good" attributes={} children=3
    ├── Text scope=1:1..1:4 anchor=null attributes={} literal="text" children=0
    ├── SoftBreak scope=1:5..1:5 anchor=null attributes={} children=0
    └── Text scope=2:5..2:8 anchor=null attributes={} literal="more" children=0
````````````````````````````````

## empty-item

```````````````````````````````` example
- #id#
.
Document scope=1:1..1:6 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── List scope=1:1..1:6 anchor=null attributes={} flavor=bullet start=null variant=null delimiter=null tight=true children=1
    └── ListItem scope=1:1..1:6 anchor="id" attributes={} marker=null children=1
        └── Paragraph scope=1:3..1:6 anchor=null attributes={} children=0
````````````````````````````````

## task-item

```````````````````````````````` example
- [✓] item #task#
.
Document scope=1:1..1:19 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── List scope=1:1..1:19 anchor=null attributes={} flavor=bullet start=null variant=null delimiter=null tight=true children=1
    └── ListItem scope=1:1..1:19 anchor="task" attributes={} marker="✓" children=1
        └── Paragraph scope=1:9..1:19 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
            └── Text scope=1:9..1:12 anchor=null attributes={} literal="item" children=0
````````````````````````````````

## later-paragraph

```````````````````````````````` example
- first

  second #p#
.
Document scope=1:1..3:12 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── List scope=1:1..3:12 anchor=null attributes={} flavor=bullet start=null variant=null delimiter=null tight=false children=1
    └── ListItem scope=1:1..3:12 anchor=null attributes={} marker=null children=2
        ├── Paragraph scope=1:3..1:7 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
        │   └── Text scope=1:3..1:7 anchor=null attributes={} literal="first" children=0
        └── Paragraph scope=3:3..3:12 anchor="p" attributes={} children=1
            └── Text scope=3:3..3:8 anchor=null attributes={} literal="second" children=0
````````````````````````````````

## earlier-candidates

```````````````````````````````` example
text #a# #b#
more #last#
.
Document scope=1:1..2:11 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── Paragraph scope=1:1..2:11 anchor="last" attributes={} children=3
    ├── Text scope=1:1..1:12 anchor=null attributes={} literal="text #a# #b#" children=0
    ├── SoftBreak scope=1:13..1:13 anchor=null attributes={} children=0
    └── Text scope=2:1..2:4 anchor=null attributes={} literal="more" children=0
````````````````````````````````

## nested-outer

```````````````````````````````` example
- outer
  - inner

#outer#

next
.
Document scope=1:1..6:4 anchor=null attributes={} children=2
├── List scope=1:1..4:7 anchor="outer" attributes={} flavor=bullet start=null variant=null delimiter=null tight=true children=1
│   └── ListItem scope=1:1..3:0 anchor=null attributes={} marker=null children=2
│       ├── Paragraph scope=1:3..1:7 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│       │   └── Text scope=1:3..1:7 anchor=null attributes={} literal="outer" children=0
│       └── List scope=2:3..3:0 anchor=null attributes={} flavor=bullet start=null variant=null delimiter=null tight=true children=1
│           └── ListItem scope=2:3..3:0 anchor=null attributes={} marker=null children=1
│               └── Paragraph scope=2:5..2:9 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│                   └── Text scope=2:5..2:9 anchor=null attributes={} literal="inner" children=0
└── Paragraph scope=6:1..6:4 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    └── Text scope=6:1..6:4 anchor=null attributes={} literal="next" children=0
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example

  - inner

  rest

└── List scope=1:1..6:6 anchor=null attributes={} flavor=bullet start=null variant=null delimiter=null tight=false children=1
    └── ListItem scope=1:1..6:6 anchor=null attributes={} marker=null children=3
        ├── Paragraph scope=1:3..1:7 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
        │   └── Text scope=1:3..1:7 anchor=null attributes={} literal="outer" children=0
        ├── List scope=2:3..4:9 anchor="inner" attributes={} flavor=bullet start=null variant=null delimiter=null tight=true children=1
        │   └── ListItem scope=2:3..3:0 anchor=null attributes={} marker=null children=1
        │       └── Paragraph scope=2:5..2:9 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
        │           └── Text scope=2:5..2:9 anchor=null attributes={} literal="inner" children=0
        └── Paragraph scope=6:3..6:6 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
            └── Text scope=6:3..6:6 anchor=null attributes={} literal="rest" children=0
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
    │   └── ListItem scope=1:3..2:1 anchor=null attributes={} marker=null children=1
    │       └── Paragraph scope=1:5..1:8 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    │           └── Text scope=1:5..1:8 anchor=null attributes={} literal="item" children=0

        └── Text scope=5:3..5:6 anchor=null attributes={} literal="rest" children=0
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
.

├── Callout scope=1:1..3:8 anchor=null attributes={} variant=null collapsed=null children=2
│   ├── List scope=1:3..2:1 anchor=null attributes={} flavor=bullet start=null variant=null delimiter=null tight=true children=1
│   │   └── ListItem scope=1:3..2:1 anchor=null attributes={} marker=null children=1
│   │       └── Paragraph scope=1:5..1:8 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│   │           └── Text scope=1:5..1:8 anchor=null attributes={} literal="item" children=0

    └── Text scope=5:1..5:7 anchor=null attributes={} literal="outside" children=0
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
│   └── Text scope=1:1..1:10 anchor=null attributes={} literal="text #a_b#" children=0

│   └── Text scope=3:1..3:9 anchor=null attributes={} literal="text #é#" children=0

    └── Text scope=5:1..5:10 anchor=null attributes={} literal="text #a.b#" children=0
````````````````````````````````

## heading-boundaries

```````````````````````````````` example
├── Heading scope=1:1..1:14 anchor="heading-id" attributes={} level=1 children=1
│   └── Text scope=1:3..1:14 anchor=null attributes={} literal="heading #id#" children=0
├── Heading scope=3:1..3:6 anchor="id" attributes={} level=1 children=1
````````````````````````````````

## opaque-blocks

```````````````````````````````` example

```

%%

%%
````````````````````````````````
